items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: So at this point I've been with Lester Lanin for about 35 years.

ctx.x: I think so. I've got enough memories to think about what happened in those years. You keep track of the years, I know that you're aware of what years that would be in. So at this point I've been with Lester Lanin for about 35 years.
Outside of the fact that we have another chapter coming on out of two years that I left to go with Armstrong again. This time it's not the big band, I joined the All Stars.
